title: Optimize / Evals 1:1 prep - quality regressions & A/B follow-ups
content:
Meeting: Optimize / Evals 1:1 (prep)
Owner: Aisha Khan
Objective: Quick sync ahead of weekly eval review - align on regressions, pick prompt sets for triage, agree on next A/B rollouts and immediate action items.

Background / what I care about:
- Last week's A/B (quantized-v2 vs baseline) showed a small but consistent drop on 'conciseness' slice for long-form summarization (delta: -3.8 points, n=420).
- Some fuzziness in toxicity classifier upstream changed a few anchor prompts; uncertain if model or eval noise.
- Prefix caching experiment delayed; blocking larger A/B rollout that needs reduced cost to meet budget.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick readout of A/B metrics & uncertainty (5m)
   - show per-slice breakdown (long-form summarization, instruction-following, safety)
   - call out which slices exceed our alert thresholds (+/-2.5)
2) Triaging the conciseness regression (10m)
   - which prompt sets show largest deltas? (top 3 prompts)
   - sanity checks: sampling variance, seed sensitivity, metric instrumentation changes
3) Safety/toxicity noise investigation (5m)
   - confirm classifier version used in eval; compare to prod classifier
4) Rollout plan for quantized-v2 (5m)
   - options: pause, canary narrower slice, or revert and iterate
5) Action items & owners (5m)

Pre-read notes / quick datapoints:
- Overall A/B summary: quantized-v2 vs baseline
  - throughput: +22% tokens/sec (expected)
  - cost per token: -18% (on-target)
  - metric regressions: conciseness (long-form) -3.8, factuality (news) -0.9 (within noise), safety +0.3
  - p-values: conciseness p=0.01 (bootstrap), other slices p>0.2

- Top affected prompt sets for conciseness (by effect size):
  1) prompt-id: summarize-long-threads-01 - delta -5.4 (n=120)
  2) prompt-id: executive-brief-8k - delta -4.1 (n=95)
  3) prompt-id: research-synopsis-4k - delta -3.6 (n=85)

- Quick checks to run before next meeting (proposed order):
  A) Re-run conciseness metric with 5 different random seeds (small sample) to measure variance (owner: Aisha) - target by EOD tomorrow
  B) Run small decoding (temperature/beam) sweep on quantized-v2 for top-3 prompts to see if decoding change reduces conciseness drop (owner: Jamie) - 2 days
  C) Confirm toxicity classifier version & replicate safety results on a 200-sample subset (owner: Casey) - 1 day
  D) Run inference traces for one long-form prompt to inspect KV cache & attention patterns for quantized-v2 vs baseline (owner: infra/serving, contact: Samir Patel) - request ticket raised (JIRA-ENG-789)

Decision criteria for rollout next steps:
- If conciseness delta persists after A+B and p remains <0.05, narrow canary (only short-form and non-news) or rollback quantized-v2 globally.
- If p rises >0.1 with re-runs or decoding tweaks restore conciseness by >=2 points, continue canary with monitoring and prefix-caching enablement.

Risks & notes:
- Prefix caching not yet enabled in canary infra; without it, cost gains won't reach SLAs - blocking full rollout.
- Known sampling instability on the conciseness metric for prompts >4k tokens; bootstrap may underestimate variance. Need larger n for those prompts.

Questions for the 1:1 (to discuss with manager):
- How aggressive should we be on cost wins? Is a small UX regression acceptable for a 15-20% cost reduction short-term if we can schedule a fast prompt-level fallback?
- Prioritization: should we pause the rollout or continue narrow canary while we debug?

Suggested action items (owners, due):
- Aisha: run seed variance re-runs for top-3 prompts (due: 2026-03-04)
- Jamie: decoding sweep + sample comparisons (due: 2026-03-05)
- Casey: safety classifier confirmation & replicate + short writeup (due: 2026-03-04)
- Samir (infra): schedule trace run and check KV cache differences (link JIRA-ENG-789) (due: 2026-03-06)
- Product: decide canary policy (narrow vs pause) - ping Sarah Gomez for quick call (Aisha to set up) (due: 2026-03-05)

Follow-ups to add to calendar:
- Quick triage sync (15m) after A/B re-runs - target 2026-03-04 11:00am PT
- Full A/B review in weekly evals (30m) - include product & SRE for rollout discussion 2026-03-06

Notes-to-self:
- Keep a copy of the raw outputs for top-3 prompts (store in sheet:1G2hExampleId-AB-results) - helpful for audits.
- If we rollback, prepare a customer-facing blurb about transient quality adjustments and rollback rationale.

End of prep doc.
